acceptanceCriteria: affected selects a spec that imports a changed module through a tsconfig path alias on the V1-0958 fixture.
Unresolved aliases keep the existing fail-closed frontier.
body: V1-0958 (issue 659) resolves tsconfig baseUrl/paths for impact through NewWebImportResolver (internal/contextindex/webresolve.go). The affected adapter still reports the typescript:path-alias-unresolved frontier and fails closed. Reuse the resolver so affected selects aliased specs too.
title: affected: resolve TypeScript path aliases instead of failing closed on typescript:path-alias-unresolved
